run_convert_all_pddls_to_sas: run convert_all_pddls_to_sas to convert all PDDL files in a directory to SAS format using Fast Downward
run_pddl_to_sas: run pddl_to_sas to convert a single PDDL domain and problem pair into an SAS file
test_convert_all_pddls_to_sas: test convert_all_pddls_to_sas with a directory of PDDL domain and problem file pairs
refactor_pddl_to_sas: refactor pddl_to_sas to accept a custom Fast Downward executable path
review_convert_all_pddls_to_sas: review convert_all_pddls_to_sas to iterate subdirectories and convert matching PDDL pairs to SAS
